headword: {十中八九|じっちゅうはっく}
gloss: in all likelihood; nine times out of ten

definitions.gloss: in all likelihood; almost certainly; nine times out of ten
definitions.explanation: Literally "eight or nine out of ten." Used when the speaker is nearly, but not completely, sure that something is or will be the case.

examples.japanese: {十中八九|じっちゅうはっく}⟦{間違|まちが}いない→間違いない：17813_machigainai⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十中八九|じっちゅうはっく}⟦{遅|おく}れて→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧だろう。
examples.english: Nine times out of ten, he'll be late.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{空模様|そらもよう}→空模様：19362_soramoyou⟧なら、⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十中八九|じっちゅうはっく}⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: Judging by the sky, I think it will almost certainly rain this afternoon.

notes:
Also read じゅっちゅうはっく; じっちゅうはっく is the traditional reading. Usually works as an adverb before a guess, often ending in だろう, ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧ or ⟦{間違|まちが}いない→間違いない：17813_machigainai⟧.

- {十中八九|じっちゅうはっく}〜だろう: in all likelihood ~
- {十中八九|じっちゅうはっく}⟦{間違|まちが}いない→間違いない：17813_machigainai⟧: almost certainly true
- {十中八九|じっちゅうはっく}⟦{成功|せいこう}する→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧: will very likely succeed
